$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
printf 'ROOT_README\n'; if test -f README.md; then cat README.md; else echo ABSENT; fi
printf 'NESTED_DOCUMENTS\n'; for p in terminal/AGENTS.md terminal/README.md terminal/tasks/AGENTS.md terminal/tasks/README.md terminal/tasks/fishFry/AGENTS.md terminal/tasks/fishFry/README.md; do if test -f "$p"; then printf '\nDOCUMENT %s\n' "$p"; cat "$p"; fi; done
SRC='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724.png'
DIR='terminal/tasks/fishFry/mesh_vertical_line_sweep_11_to_15'
printf 'SOURCE_FILE\n'; file "$SRC"
printf 'SOURCE_SHA256\n'; sha256sum "$SRC"
printf 'SOURCE_STAT\n'; stat -c '%s bytes' "$SRC"
printf 'TARGET_DIRECTORY '; test -e "$DIR" && echo EXISTS || echo ABSENT
printf 'PYTHON_PILLOW '; python3 -c 'import PIL; print(PIL.__version__)' || echo UNAVAILABLE
printf 'GIT_HEAD ';git rev-parse HEAD
